other_conditions: Applicant must have experience in animal husbandry or artificial insemination
Applicant must be physically fit for fieldwork
Applicant must possess basic knowledge of vaccination and castration procedures
benefits_summary: Honorarium paid per animal service and event, e.g., ₹20 per calf castration, ₹400 per camp, ₹7/₹5 per vaccination, and ₹1,500 per village survey.
